automatic-issue-deduplication.yml (481B)

      1 name: Automatic New Issue Deduplication
      2 on:
      3   issues:
      4     types: [opened, reopened]
      5 permissions:
      6   models: read
      7   issues: write
      8 concurrency:
      9   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.issue.number }}
     10   cancel-in-progress: true
     11 jobs:
     12   deduplicate:
     13     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     14     steps:
     15       - name: Run Deduplicate Action
     16         uses: pelikhan/action-genai-issue-dedup@v0
     17         with:
     18           github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
     19           label_as_duplicate: true
